title: Console page:tabs shows a count badge for related lists bound by parentDataSource on an app page
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ① the framework half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4304 item 4 (a task on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」), measured at cloud's pin `b914e724` by the card thread (measurement file on the seat's order folder). Dedupe: `page:tabs badge count parentDataSource` finds objectstack#26613 (the list-count channel) and no card on the badge.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4304 (hosted console Team page).

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：应用页上的 `page:tabs`，如果标签里的关联列表用 `parentDataSource` 绑定父记录，标签上也显示数量徽标。
- 为什么：云端 Team 页发出邀请后，「邀请」标签上没有数字，只有点开标签才看到「待接受 1」；原因是徽标只在有记录上下文时才计数。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

1. Seen: a page whose tabs are each a `record:related_list` with `parentDataSource: { object: 'sys_organization', filter: id = {current_org_id} }` draws no badge; the count appears only inside the opened tab.
2. Cause: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:731` derives the badge probe only from `ctx?.recordId`; an app page has no record context, so no probe runs.
3. Want: resolve the probe's parent from the list's own `parentDataSource`, or let the panel's list report its matched count (the objectstack#26613 channel), so the badge shows on app pages too.
4. Done when a test pins: a `page:tabs` on an app page with a `parentDataSource` related list shows its row count before the tab is opened, and record-page badges behave as before.

Reader: framework console lane. Cloud half (home Members card and Team header line) ships in objectstack-ai/cloud#4304.
